import kit

types = [
    {"name": "I4", "kind": "int", "bits": 4},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "S3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
    {"name": "ARR", "kind": "array", "element": "I4", "size": 3},
    {"name": "AA", "kind": "array", "element": "ARR", "size": 2},
    {"name": "E0", "kind": "enum", "values": ["x", "y"]},
    {"name": "ST", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["n", "I4"], ["a", "ARR"], ["s", "S3"]]},
    {"name": "EMPTY", "kind": "array", "element": "I4", "size": 0},
    {"name": "CH", "kind": "char"},
]
PARAMS = [["n", "I4"], ["a", "ARR"], ["s", "S3"], ["st", "ST"], ["aa", "AA"],
          ["e", "E0"], ["em", "EMPTY"], ["c", "CH"]]
BASE = {"types": types, "modules": [], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
        "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}


def build(predicate):
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": PARAMS, "result": ["r", "B"],
                "requires": predicate}]
    return dict(BASE, modules=modules)


def leaves(n=0, a=(0, 0, 0), s=(0, 0, 0), st=(0, (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0)),
           aa=((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0)), e=0, c=0, r=0):
    """Leaf values in slot (object) order."""
    out = [n, a[0], a[1], a[2], s[0], s[1], s[2],
           st[0], st[1][0], st[1][1], st[1][2], st[2][0], st[2][1], st[2][2],
           aa[0][0], aa[0][1], aa[0][2], aa[1][0], aa[1][1], aa[1][2],
           e, c, r]
    return out


def verdict(predicate, **kwargs):
    campaign = build(predicate)
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m",
                         "ktest": kit.test_ktest(plan, leaves(**kwargs), r=None)
                         if False else kit.encode(
                             [(name, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (name, p, w), v in
                              zip(plan["slots"], leaves(**kwargs))])}]
    out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
    return out["records"][0]["status"], out["corpus"]


def const(v):
    return v


checks = [
    # all over an array
    (["all", "v", ["var", "a"], ["le", ["var", "v"], ["const", "I4", 9]]],
     dict(a=(1, 2, 9)), "READY"),
    (["all", "v", ["var", "a"], ["le", ["var", "v"], ["const", "I4", 9]]],
     dict(a=(1, 2, 10)), "FILTERED"),
    # all over an empty array is true
    (["not", ["all", "v", ["var", "em"], ["const", "B", False]]], dict(), "READY"),
    # binding shadowing a parameter, lexical scoping
    (["and", ["all", "n", ["var", "a"], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 1]]],
      ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 7]]], dict(n=7, a=(1, 1, 1)), "READY"),
    (["and", ["all", "n", ["var", "a"], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 1]]],
      ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 7]]], dict(n=8, a=(1, 1, 1)), "FILTERED"),
    # nested bindings with the same name
    (["all", "v", ["var", "aa"], ["all", "w", ["var", "v"],
      ["gt", ["var", "w"], ["const", "I4", 0]]]], dict(aa=((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6))), "READY"),
    (["all", "v", ["var", "aa"], ["all", "w", ["var", "v"],
      ["gt", ["var", "w"], ["const", "I4", 0]]]], dict(aa=((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 0))), "FILTERED"),
    # exact modular arithmetic
    (["eq", ["add", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 13]], ["const", "I4", 5]],
     dict(n=8), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["sub", ["const", "I4", 3], ["const", "I4", 5]], ["const", "I4", 14]],
     dict(), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["sub", ["const", "I4", 3], ["const", "I4", 5]], ["const", "I4", -2]],
     dict(), "FILTERED"),
    # deep equality on arrays and structs
    (["eq", ["var", "a"], ["const", "ARR", [1, 2, 3]]], dict(a=(1, 2, 3)), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["var", "a"], ["const", "ARR", [1, 2, 3]]], dict(a=(1, 2, 4)), "FILTERED"),
    (["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "ST", {"n": 1, "a": [2, 3, 4], "s": "x"}]],
     dict(st=(1, (2, 3, 4), (ord("x"), 0, 0))), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "ST", {"n": 1, "a": [2, 3, 4], "s": "x"}]],
     dict(st=(1, (2, 3, 4), (ord("y"), 0, 0))), "FILTERED"),
    # strings: recovery truncates at NUL, constants do not
    (["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "S3", "a\u0000b"]], dict(s=(97, 0, 98)), "FILTERED"),
    (["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "S3", "a"]], dict(s=(97, 0, 98)), "READY"),
    (["ne", ["var", "s"], ["const", "S3", "a\u0000b"]], dict(s=(97, 0, 98)), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "S3", "abc"]], dict(s=(97, 98, 99)), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "S3", "ab"]], dict(s=(97, 98, 99)), "FILTERED"),
    # index / field access
    (["eq", ["index", ["var", "a"], 1], ["const", "I4", 2]], dict(a=(0, 2, 0)), "READY"),
    (["eq", ["field", ["var", "st"], "n"], ["const", "I4", 5]], dict(st=(5,)), "READY"),
    # match semantics
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "[a-c]*"], dict(s=(97, 98, 99)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "[a-c]*"], dict(s=(97, 100, 0)), "FILTERED"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], ""], dict(s=(0, 0, 0)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "a|ab"], dict(s=(97, 98, 0)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "(a|ab)c"], dict(s=(97, 99, 0)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "a\\.b"], dict(s=(97, 46, 98)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "a.b"], dict(s=(97, 46, 98)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "a.b"], dict(s=(97, 120, 98)), "FILTERED"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "a*"], dict(s=(97, 97, 0)), "READY"),
    (["match", ["var", "s"], "()*"], dict(s=(97, 0, 0)), "FILTERED"),
    # boolean forms
    (["implies", ["const", "B", False], ["const", "B", False]], dict(), "READY"),
    (["implies", ["const", "B", True], ["const", "B", False]], dict(), "FILTERED"),
    (["or", ["const", "B", True], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 9]]], dict(n=1), "READY"),
    (["and", ["const", "B", False], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I4", 9]]], dict(n=1), "FILTERED"),
    (["not", ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "E0", "y"]]], dict(e=1), "FILTERED"),
    (["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "E0", "y"]], dict(e=1), "READY"),
    # null predicate means true
    (None, dict(), "READY"),
]

failures = 0
for predicate, kwargs, want in checks:
    got, corpus = verdict(predicate, **kwargs)
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print("FAIL %s %s -> %s want %s" % (kit.json if False else "", predicate, got, want))
    else:
        print("pass %-14s %s" % (got, str(predicate)[:70]))
print("failures", failures)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 t_pred.py 2>&1 | tail -50
